betterflying.config.title: Better Flying
betterflying.config.doubleTapJumpToToggl: Toggles flight in creative mode when the jump key is pressed twice quickly.
betterflying.config.flyOnGroundInCreativ: Stays flying when touching the ground in creative mode. Sneak twice quickly to land.
betterflying.config.disableChangingFovWh: Stops the field of view from changing while flying in creative or spectator mode.
betterflying.config.flightInertiaMultipl: Lower values slow you down faster when no movement keys are held. 1.00 is vanilla.
betterflying.config.flightHorizontalSpee: Horizontal flight speed multiplier in creative mode while not holding the sprint key. 1.00 is vanilla.
Horizontal flight speed multiplier in creative mode while holding the sprint key. 2.00 is vanilla.
betterflying.config.flightVerticalSpeedM: Vertical flight speed multiplier in creative mode while not holding the sprint key. 1.00 is vanilla.
Vertical flight speed multiplier in creative mode while holding the sprint key. Vanilla has no sprint boost, so 1.00 keeps the vanilla vertical speed.
betterflying.config.flightHorizontalSpee: Horizontal flight speed multiplier in spectator mode while not holding the sprint key. 1.00 is vanilla.
Horizontal flight speed multiplier in spectator mode while holding the sprint key. 2.00 is vanilla.
betterflying.config.flightVerticalSpeedM: Vertical flight speed multiplier in spectator mode while not holding the sprint key. 1.00 is vanilla.
Vertical flight speed multiplier in spectator mode while holding the sprint key. Vanilla has no sprint boost, so 1.00 keeps the vanilla vertical speed.
betterflying.config.toggleFlightModifier: Modifier key that must be held down for the Toggle Flight keybind to trigger.
